title: HeteroSVD: Efficient SVD Accelerator on Versal ACAP with Algorithm-Hardware Co-Design
problem: Singular value decomposition (SVD) has O(n^3) complexity; real-time SVD applications (signal processing, recommendations) require acceleration. GPU and FPGA solutions don't jointly optimize latency, throughput, and power.
motivation: SVD is a critical primitive in signal processing and linear algebra; practical systems need low-latency, power-efficient implementations.
method: The accelerator combines different processor types on a Xilinx Versal ACAP chip—FPGA logic, CPUs, and specialized AI Engine cores designed for matrix math. The SVD algorithm is reorganized to align with what the AI Engines do best, and an automated tool explores different ways to split work across these components, picking the layout with the fastest speed and lowest power consumption.
key_novelty: The core idea is jointly optimizing the SVD algorithm and hardware layout to exploit Versal ACAP's AI Engine processors.
contributions: 1.98x latency reduction vs FPGA, 7.22x vs GPU
1.77x throughput and 13.18x energy efficiency vs GPU
limitations: Not discussed; applicability to larger matrices and distributed SVD not addressed.
primary_theme: FPGA SVD acceleration with AI Engine co-optimization
